'''Kevrim al'Azar''' is a resident of the [[Two Rivers]].

== Appearance and History ==
He is perhaps the oldest person in the [[Two Rivers]]. He has grandsons who have grown sons.{{ref/book|4|56}}

== Activities ==
He helps defend [[Emond's Field]] against the invading [[Trolloc]] army.{{ref/book|4|56}}
